description: Android 15 / API 35 behavioral audit (the project ALREADY compiles/targets API 35, so this is NOT a migration) plus a new API 35 emulator smoke-test CI workflow. Audit the components actually affected by Android 15 behavior changes using the official Android docs, change ONLY what is genuinely required, and add an automated smoke test that honestly qualifies what CI can and explicitly marks the rest HUMAN/PHYSICAL. KEY AUDIT FINDING (confirmed from https://developer.android.com/about/versions/15/behavior-changes-15): the app's foreground service is foregroundServiceType=specialUse, which is NOT in Android 15's list of BOOT_COMPLETED-restricted FGS types (dataSync, camera, mediaPlayback, phoneCall, mediaProjection, microphone), so the boot-prepare startForegroundService path remains PERMITTED on API 35. The SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW narrowing affects background FGS starts (needs a visible overlay first); the app starts the FGS from a user Activity action or from the BOOT_COMPLETED exemption path, and draws the overlay lazily — document whether any change is needed. PendingIntent already uses FLAG_IMMUTABLE. Prefer documentation over code churn; only touch files if a demonstrated API-35 necessity exists, and NEVER touch the interdicted MediaSyncedTrackScheduler / MediaIdentityMatcher unless an API-35 necessity is demonstrated and justified in writing.
steps: Audit each surface against Android 15 behavior changes and record findings (in this feature's findings field and later in the doc): (1) OverlayService specialUse FGS start from BootReceiver — permitted (specialUse not restricted); (2) SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW + background FGS narrowing — the FGS is started from an Activity user action (foreground) or BootReceiver (BOOT_COMPLETED path), onStartCommand guards on Settings.canDrawOverlays and stops if absent, overlay drawn lazily; determine if any ordering change is required and conclude; (3) BootReceiver — not directBootAware, listens only to BOOT_COMPLETED/MY_PACKAGE_REPLACED, wrapped fail-closed; (4) NotificationListenerService / MediaSession access — unchanged by API 35; (5) exported components — MainActivity exported true (launcher), others exported false, BootReceiver exported true (required for BOOT_COMPLETED); (6) PendingIntent mutability — already FLAG_IMMUTABLE; (7) edge-to-edge / 16KB page size / other API-35 items — assess relevance for a leanback TV POC and state N/A with reason.

If and only if a concrete API-35 necessity is found, make the minimal change (e.g. a manifest attribute or a code guard) and justify it. If no change is required, make NO code change and state that explicitly — the correct outcome for an app already targeting 35 may be zero code changes. Do NOT perform cosmetic refactors. Do NOT edit interdicted files.

Create .github/workflows/android-15-smoke.yml: workflow_dispatch (and optionally pull_request to main) on ubuntu-latest. setup-java 17, setup-android, gradle 8.9, sdkmanager platforms;android-35 + build-tools;35.0.0. Build the Cloud-mode debug APK (SCENEVIBE_CLOUD_ORIGIN set) for install. Use reactivecircus/android-emulator-runner@v2 with api-level 35. Prefer an Android TV system image if an officially usable one exists for api 35 (investigate `system-images;android-35;android-tv;x86_64` or google_apis variants); if no usable TV image exists, fall back to a standard api-35 image (e.g. google_apis / default x86_64) and EXPLICITLY declare in the workflow comments and job name that this qualifies Android-15 platform invariants only, NOT Android TV, and must never be called 'physical Android TV qualification'.

In the emulator run script, attempt honestly (each as a checked step, failing the job on a real failure, but marking untestable items as skipped/HUMAN-REQUIRED rather than faking a pass): adb install the APK; `adb shell am start -n com.scenevibe.tvcompanionpoc/.MainActivity` then check `adb shell dumpsys activity activities | grep MainActivity` resumed and no immediate crash; scan logcat for AndroidRuntime FATAL EXCEPTION and fail if present; verify the package is present via `adb shell pm list packages | grep com.scenevibe.tvcompanionpoc`. For the foreground service: because OverlayService requires SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW + user action and specialUse FGS, grant overlay via `adb shell appops set com.scenevibe.tvcompanionpoc SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW allow` where possible and attempt to observe the service, but if the service cannot be honestly started/observed headlessly, mark FGS-alive and overlay-visible as HUMAN/PHYSICAL REQUIRED in the step output rather than asserting a false PASS. For reboot/boot path: if `adb reboot` + wait + re-check package presence is cleanly testable in the runner, do it; otherwise mark boot-path as HUMAN/PHYSICAL REQUIRED.
Ensure the workflow never prints a PASS for a check it did not actually perform. Every honestly-unqualifiable item must emit an explicit 'HUMAN/PHYSICAL REQUIRED' notice.

Validate locally what is possible: YAML well-formedness of the new workflow; and the audit conclusions. The emulator itself is CI-ONLY (no KVM/AVD locally) — do not attempt to boot an emulator in the sandbox; state this clearly. If any code change was made, re-run assembleDebug + assembleRelease + testDebugUnitTest + python tests to prove no regression and that the interdicted behavior is intact.
acceptance_criteria: A written Android 15 audit covering FGS/specialUse, BOOT_COMPLETED FGS restrictions, SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW background-FGS narrowing, boot receiver, notification listener/MediaSession, exported components, and PendingIntent, each with a concrete keep/change conclusion grounded in the official Android 15 docs.
Only genuinely-required API-35 changes are made (possibly zero); no interdicted file modified without a demonstrated+justified API-35 necessity; no cosmetic refactor.

.github/workflows/android-15-smoke.yml exists, uses an API 35 emulator, prefers an Android TV image if usable and otherwise clearly declares the standard-image limitation (never calling it Android TV physical qualification).

The smoke test attempts install, MainActivity launch, no-immediate-crash, no AndroidRuntime fatal, package-present, and (where honestly possible) service/FGS and reboot checks; items not honestly qualifiable in CI emit explicit HUMAN/PHYSICAL REQUIRED notices and are not reported as PASS.
If any code changed, assembleDebug, assembleRelease, testDebugUnitTest, and Python boundary tests all still pass with no weakened assertions.
verification: python3 -c "import yaml; yaml.safe_load(open('.github/workflows/android-15-smoke.yml')); print('smoke workflow YAML OK')"
findings:
OUTCOME: ZERO app code / manifest changes required. The app already compiles and targets compileSdk/targetSdk 35; the Android 15 behavior-change audit found every affected surface already compliant. The ONLY new artifact is .github/workflows/android-15-smoke.yml (an API 35 emulator smoke test). The Python boundary test (tests/test_poc_contract.py) is untouched and still passes 12/12 unchanged.

PER-SURFACE ANDROID 15 AUDIT (grounded in https://developer.android.com/about/versions/15/behavior-changes-15):
1. OverlayService specialUse FGS started from BootReceiver -> KEEP (no change). Android 15 forbids BOOT_COMPLETED receivers from launching these FGS types: dataSync, camera, mediaPlayback, phoneCall, mediaProjection, microphone. OverlayService is foregroundServiceType=specialUse, which is NOT in that list, so BootReceiver.arm() -> startForegroundService(ACTION_BOOT_PREPARE) remains PERMITTED on API 35. BootReceiver already wraps the start in try/catch and degrades to a diagnostic (fail-closed), so even a future platform ForegroundServiceStartNotAllowedException cannot crash boot.
2. SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW + background-FGS narrowing -> KEEP (no ordering change needed). Under targetSdk 35 an app may start an FGS from the background under the SAW exemption ONLY if it already has a VISIBLE overlay window. This project never relies on that background-SAW path: the FGS is started (a) from an explicit user Activity action in MainActivity.startOverlay(), which runs in the foreground and is guarded by Settings.canDrawOverlays(this) before startForegroundService(), or (b) from the BOOT_COMPLETED exemption path in BootReceiver. OverlayService.onStartCommand() independently re-checks Settings.canDrawOverlays() and stopSelf()s if absent, and the overlay window is drawn lazily (only when a comment is due, never from boot). Because no start depends on the background-SAW exemption, no 'draw overlay before starting FGS' reordering is required. CONCLUSION: no change.
3. BootReceiver -> KEEP (no change). Listens only to BOOT_COMPLETED and MY_PACKAGE_REPLACED, is NOT directBootAware and NOT registered for LOCKED_BOOT_COMPLETED (so it runs only after user unlock / CE storage available), exported=true (required to receive BOOT_COMPLETED), and the entire body is fail-closed. Unaffected by Android 15.
4. NotificationListenerService / MediaSession access (MediaSessionAccessService) -> KEEP (no change). Android 15 introduced no behavior change to NotificationListenerService binding or MediaSessionManager.getActiveSessions() access gating relevant here. The listener remains exported=false with permission BIND_NOTIFICATION_LISTENER_SERVICE and is passive (no onNotificationPosted). N/A.
5. Exported components -> KEEP (no change). MainActivity exported=true (leanback launcher, required), DiagnosticsActivity exported=false, OverlayService exported=false, MediaSessionAccessService exported=false, BootReceiver exported=true (required for BOOT_COMPLETED). All already satisfy the API 31+ explicit-exported rule; Android 15 adds nothing here.
6. PendingIntent mutability -> KEEP (no change). OverlayService's only PendingIntent (PendingIntent.getActivity for the notification contentIntent) already uses FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT | FLAG_IMMUTABLE, satisfying the API 31+ explicit-mutability requirement that Android 15 continues to enforce.
7. Other API-35 items -> N/A with reason. (a) Edge-to-edge enforcement for apps targeting 35: applies to apps drawing their own window insets on handsets; this is a leanback TV POC using Theme.Material.NoActionBar with a simple control list and a system overlay window, not an edge-to-edge content app, and TV has no status/navigation bar inset model of concern -> N/A. (b) 16 KB memory page size: affects apps with native (.so/NDK) libraries; this app is pure Java/AndroidX with no NDK code -> N/A. (c) DND / global state and other media/connectivity items: the app sends no transport controls and does not mutate global DND or interruption-filter state -> N/A. (d) Partial-screen screen sharing, secure background activity launch, etc.: no screen capture and no background Activity launches (BootReceiver never launches MainActivity) -> N/A.

SMOKE WORKFLOW (.github/workflows/android-15-smoke.yml) — WHAT IT ACTUALLY VERIFIES vs HUMAN/PHYSICAL:
- Triggers: workflow_dispatch + pull_request to main. ubuntu-latest, setup-java 17, setup-android, gradle 8.9, sdkmanager platforms;android-35 + build-tools;35.0.0. Builds the Cloud-mode debug APK (SCENEVIBE_CLOUD_ORIGIN=https://interface-scenevibe-3wxg.vercel.app). Enables KVM, then reactivecircus/android-emulator-runner@v2 api-level 35.
- IMAGE / SCOPE HONESTY: no officially usable Android TV (leanback) system image exists for API 35 (system-images;android-35;android-tv;* does not resolve), so it boots a STANDARD api-35 google_apis x86_64 image. The workflow comments AND the job name ('Android 15 API 35 platform invariants (standard image, NOT Android TV)') EXPLICITLY declare this qualifies Android-15 PLATFORM INVARIANTS ONLY and is never an 'Android TV' or 'physical qualification'. The script even checks pm list features for android.software.leanback and emits a HUMAN/PHYSICAL notice because it is absent.
- ACTUALLY VERIFIED (fail job on real failure): Cloud-mode APK build artifact present; adb install -r; package present via pm list packages (grep package:com.scenevibe.tvcompanionpoc); am start -n .../.MainActivity; logcat scan for 'FATAL EXCEPTION'/AndroidRuntime attributed to the app (fail if present; a fatal from another process is surfaced as a notice, not a fake pass); MainActivity present in dumpsys activity activities stack; weak install-persistence lower bound after am force-stop.
- MARKED HUMAN/PHYSICAL REQUIRED (never printed as PASS): Android TV leanback runtime (standard image lacks leanback); OverlayService specialUse FGS actually started + 'FGS alive' + overlay window visible (requires real D-pad 'Start SceneVibe' user action and a visible overlay surface; the workflow attempts appops set SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW allow for completeness but does NOT assert the FGS is alive); the real BOOT_COMPLETED autostart path (needs opt-in ON + overlay/MediaSession access + genuine reboot); true device reboot. The resumed/top-activity check downgrades to a HUMAN notice if the resumed-activity line cannot be confirmed headlessly rather than faking a pass.
- A helper set (note_human/fail/ok) guarantees no 'PASS' is printed for any check not actually performed; honestly-unqualifiable items always emit an explicit HUMAN/PHYSICAL REQUIRED ::notice.

VERIFICATION RUN LOCALLY: `python3 -c "import yaml; yaml.safe_load(open('.github/workflows/android-15-smoke.yml'))"` -> 'smoke workflow YAML OK'. `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests` -> Ran 12 tests, OK. Gradle assembleDebug/assembleRelease/testDebugUnitTest were NOT re-run because NO code or manifest changed (per step 6, that re-run is conditional on a code change); the FEAT-003 green baseline therefore stands. The emulator itself is CI-ONLY (no KVM/AVD locally) and was not booted in the sandbox. No interdicted file (MediaSyncedTrackScheduler, MediaIdentityMatcher, etc.) was touched; no test deleted or weakened.
